    • sortByHierarchy

      @NotNull public static @NotNull List<qupath.lib.objects.PathObject> sortByHierarchy(@NotNull @NotNull List<qupath.lib.objects.PathObject> annotations)
      Sorts the list of annotations by each annotation's hierarchy level, with annotations deeper in the hierarchy coming last. E.G: Given the list of annotations -> [C, B, E, A, D] And the following hierarchy tree -> A ├─ B │ ├─ C │ ├─ D │ E The returned list will be -> [A, E, B, C, D]
      Parameters:
      annotations - the list of PathObject annotations to sort
      Returns:
      the sorted list of annotations

    • computeArea

      @NotNull public static @NotNull Area computeArea(@NotNull @NotNull qupath.lib.objects.PathObject annotation, boolean excludeChildrenArea)
      Calculates the area of the given annotation, optionally excluding the area of its children (such as nuclei).
      Parameters:
      annotation - the PathObject annotation to compute the area for
      excludeChildrenArea - if true the area of the children will be subtracted from the annotation's area (donut shape), otherwise the area of the chilren will be filled in the parent object
      Returns:
      the computed Area object for the annotation

    • getClassnamesPredicate

      @NotNull public static @NotNull Predicate<qupath.lib.objects.PathObject> getClassnamesPredicate(@NotNull @NotNull FilterMode mode, @NotNull @NotNull List<String> classNames)
      Returns a predicate that filters annotations based on the given class names and filter mode.
      Parameters:
      mode - the FilterMode to use for filtering FilterMode.NONE for no filtering, FilterMode.EXCLUDE for excluding the given class names, FilterMode.INCLUDE for including only the given class names
      classNames - the List<String> of class names to filter by
      Returns:
      the Predicate<PathObject> matching the given filter mode and class names

    • buildLabelMask

      @NotNull public static @NotNull AnnotationExporter.LabelResult buildLabelMask(@NotNull @NotNull List<qupath.lib.objects.PathObject> annotations, int IMG_W, int IMG_H, boolean differentiateChildren)
      Builds a label mask image and TSV formatted rows from the given annotations. The label mask image is a 16-bit grayscale image with each pixel value (or label) representing a different annotation. The TSV formatted rows are the annotations' data in a tab-separated format: Label, Centroid_X, Centroid_Y, ClassName
      Parameters:
      annotations - the List<PathObject> annotations to build the label mask from. Must be already sorted or filtered if necessary.
      IMG_W - the width of the starting image in pixels.
      IMG_H - the height of the starting image in pixels
      differentiateChildren - if true the children of each annotation will be treated as a separate label, otherwise they will be ignored.
      Returns:
      the LabelResult containing the label mask image and the TSV formatted rows.
